systems.country_label: السجل الوطني للسكان (Registre national de la population)
systems.owner: وزارة الداخلية وترقية اللامركزية والتنمية المحلية (Ministry of the Interior)
systems.tiers: enrolment available all year at the competent centres across the country; more than 5.1 million registered against 3.4 million in 2019, per the interior minister in parliament on 18 June 2026; 36,516 registered in under a year under the regime in force from early 2025
238 local commissions at commune level examining identification files
field missions and field survey campaigns that registered 613,000 citizens

note: A second report of the same parliamentary statement on enrolment in the biometric population register; it says civil-status systems were modernised and digitised from 2019 in general terms, and nothing on how or where a birth or death is registered.
